title: data for feedback.add
description: Owner note on a task, or coordinator reply. Kind sweep (owner-only, target * = the whole board, the Cập nhật button) asks the coordinator to re-check every task status; one may be open at a time (409 sweep_open); the coordinator closes it with a reply (reply_to, resolve_reply_to) or feedback.resolve. approve/reject/newtask/choice/goal-lock are owner-only; choice records an option the owner picked on a step (step_id) or a reviewer plan (plan_id) outside an ask; goal-lock (with goal_version) is how a migration records a predecessor's goal-lock row (goal.lock writes its own). target_id NEW is the board's thread of new-task requests (no task needed). An owner note/approve/reject/choice answers the open asks it lands on (on a step: that step's asks and the task's step-less asks; on the task: its step-less asks); the server journals their ids as answers_asks and the feedback stays open for the coordinator. With ask_id the message is scoped to that ask and answers only it. Kinds: redirect (Đổi hướng) and askback (Hỏi lại: the ask stays open, journaled as asks_back) are owner-only; receipt (Nhận) is coordinator-only, needs reply_to = an owner message of the task and a text with the lines 'Đổi:', 'Lịch:', 'Bước tiếp:' (parsed into receipt), is recorded on that message (received) and closes it.

ask_id.description: Scope: the message is about this ask of the task (preset when the owner opens a task from Waiting on you).

attachments.description: Images of this task (uploaded with purpose=message) shown with the message.
